tfn.s: Katy Tam and Michael Inzlicht wrote the 2024 perspective article.
tfn.why: The text says: "In a 2024 perspective article for Communications Psychology, researchers Katy Tam and Michael Inzlicht discussed evidence of rising boredom and proposed a possible explanation: digital media may sometimes make boredom worse instead of relieving it."

tfn.s: The article proves smartphones cause a worldwide rise in boredom.

tfn.s: The writers suggest digital media may contribute to the feeling it promises to remove.
tfn.why: The text says: "In a 2024 perspective published in Communications Psychology, Katy Tam and Michael Inzlicht examined this paradox and proposed that digital media might contribute to the very feeling it promises to eliminate."

tfn.s: Someone can be busy and still feel deeply bored.
tfn.why: The text says: "Someone can be busy yet deeply bored if their activities feel meaningless."

tfn.s: The article concludes that all screen time is interchangeable.
tfn.why: The text says the opposite: "Treating all screen time as interchangeable obscures those differences and risks replacing one simplistic explanation with another."
